headline: GW6: 90 mins to Deadline Thread
body: After a never ending International Break with more SHAMbolic flags at the end of it. FPL is finally back to ruin our weekends. While you might have learnt how to live without constant disappointment of your decisions, the misery will find you again soon. Whether you have already used the chips, or you have activated now, make sure you do not miss the deadline. Take those captaincy punts because if not now then when? Good luck to you all, may your salads be green, your flags be yellow, and your arrows be red.   submitted by   /u/6by6Hindsight [link]   [comments]
